AAAI open-access PDF (ojs.aaai.org article 40086, download 44047), read in full on 2026-09-18
Page 28555, Figure 1 caption: a uniform-latency SNN uses a fixed global timestep T for all layers; a hetero-latency SNN employs learnable, layer-specific timesteps T_l

Page 28555, Introduction: existing training treats T as a manually selected global hyperparameter; conversion methods often require a large fixed T to minimize approximation error from the source ANN; BPTT training cost scales with O(LT)

Page 28556, Related Work, Latency Optimization for SNNs: prior work designs a static heterogeneous latency with progressively shorter stage timesteps (Ding et al. 2024), a dynamic sample-wise latency, or trains on multiple timestep configurations for robustness; PseudoSNN learns a static heterogeneous latency configuration with no additional inference module

Page 28558, paragraph 'Rate-Coding as a Quantization Process' and Eq. (7): the time-averaged output of a soft-reset IF neuron is discrete in {0, 1/T, 2/T, ..., 1}, so the input-output relationship is a uniform quantization function with three cases (0 for non-positive input, round(input times T)/T for input in (0, 1), 1 for input at or above 1); the discrepancy from an ideal continuous activation such as ReLU gives two error sources, quantization error (the middle case) and clipping error (the final case); the quantization error is then approximated as additive noise (pseudo-quantization noise)

Page 28557, Figure 2 caption (c): the PseudoSN is inspired by the decomposition of rate-coded spike activations into a base ReLU function plus quantization and clipping error terms; (d) a hardware-aware objective penalizes energy and latency to guide the learnable timesteps

Page 28558, paragraph 'Temporal Reshaping for Heterogeneous Latency' and Eq. (13): at inference layer l runs over T_l steps; when T_l differs from T_{l-1} the layer's input is the temporal average of the previous layer's output broadcast across T_l steps
sources.notes: Holds the rate-coding-as-uniform-quantization framing that opens the survey's error-source section, the uniform-latency versus hetero-latency contrast, and a direct-training route to a learned per-layer horizon joined by an average-and-broadcast boundary; the paper reports no neuromorphic execution.
